rows.title: Radisson RED Minneapolis
rows.body:
Urban, United States, North America, OUIBar + KTCHN

Minneapolis, Minnesota

Upscale select-service · urban social hub

Reference property · flex F&B & design

Flagship North American RED with OUIBar + KTCHN communal bar-food space and bold lobby experience—press-kit photography market for playful urban positioning under Choice in the Americas.

Urban RED economics hinge on flex F&B labor and social-lobby activation—not full-service kitchen capex. Model Minneapolis-style urban ADR and event/leisure mix for your market.
